title: Customer Record
description: Reference schema for the system-of-record representation of a single customer. Field names align with SCIM 2.0 (RFC 7643), Schema.org Person, and vCard 4.0 (RFC 6350); see data-model/customer-database-data-model.yml for the field-by-field crosswalk. This is a neutral topic reference authored by API Evangelist, not a schema published by any vendor.

id.description: Opaque, stable, system-assigned identifier for the customer. Equivalent to SCIM "id" and vCard "UID".

externalId.description: Identifier assigned by a system other than this one, used to correlate the same customer across systems. Equivalent to SCIM "externalId".

name.description: Structured name. Mirrors the SCIM "name" complex attribute and the five components of vCard "N".

formatted.description: Full name as it should be displayed. vCard "FN"; Schema.org "name".

userName.description: Login handle, where the customer record is also a login. SCIM "userName".

userType.description: Record classification — prospect, customer, employee, partner. SCIM "userType"; vCard "KIND".

birthDate.description: Schema.org "birthDate"; vCard "BDAY". Special-category-adjacent in several jurisdictions; collect only with a purpose.

gender.description: Schema.org "gender"; vCard "GENDER". Free text by design — do not constrain to a closed enum.

timezone.description: IANA time zone database name, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. SCIM "timezone"; vCard "TZ".

active.description: Soft-delete flag. SCIM "active". Distinguishes a deactivated customer from a deleted one; vCard has no equivalent, so this is lost on vCard export.

organization.description: Employer or account. Mirrors the SCIM enterprise User extension and the components of vCard "ORG".

contactPoints.description: Typed, addressable channels. Multi-valued in all three source standards.

addresses.description: Structured postal addresses. SCIM "addresses"; Schema.org "address"; vCard "ADR".

consent.description: Consent history. Append-only: a withdrawal is a new record, never an edit of the prior one. No source standard models this — see the gaps section of the data model.

identityLinks.description: Edges of the identity graph. No source standard models this.

preferences.description: Channel, topic, and frequency settings — what the customer WANTS, as distinct from what they legally permitted. Keep separate from consent.

sameAs.description: Authoritative URLs for the same person elsewhere. Schema.org "sameAs".

meta.description: Record metadata. Mirrors the SCIM "meta" common attribute.

mergedFrom.description: Identifiers of records collapsed into this one, retained so a merge is auditable and reversible.
